observations: A blue and silver industrial grinding machine with a metal hopper on top.
The machine has a black motor on one end and a blue body with a visible capacitor.
It is mounted on a black metal stand with four legs.
The hopper is made of galvanized or aluminum metal, conical in shape.
The machine appears to be in a warehouse or workshop setting with concrete floor.
No visible brand or model name on the machine in either photo.
No signs of damage or wear visible in the photos.
No power cord or plug is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Wet and dry grinding machine for maize, crayfish, fish feed, powder
claims.evidence: The machine's design is consistent with a grinder, but there is no visible proof of its capability for wet or dry grinding, nor for the specific materials mentioned. The seller's claim is not contradicted by the photos but cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine running and grinding material, or a close-up of the internal grinding mechanism.

risks.risk: The machine may not support wet grinding as claimed, or may have rust or corrosion in hidden parts.
risks.proof: Close-up of the grinding chamber and internal components, especially after running with water or wet material.

risks.risk: The motor may be damaged or not compatible with Nigerian voltage (220V/50Hz).
risks.proof: Photo of the motor label showing voltage, frequency, and power rating.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing parts such as the power cord, blades, or safety guards.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included parts laid out, including the power cord and any accessories.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running and grinding material (dry and wet if possible).
Close-up photo of the motor label showing voltage, frequency, and power rating.
Photo of the internal grinding chamber and blades.
Photo of all included parts, including the power cord and any accessories.
response.reason: The machine's identity is clear as a wet and dry grinding machine, but critical claims about functionality, voltage compatibility, and completeness cannot be verified from the current photos. Without proof of working condition and specifications, the item cannot be priced accurately.
